title: Safety URL domain rule (SAF-10, extending the moderation pipeline spine, migration 0154)
description: One per-creator URL allow/deny domain rule. There is no 'global' scope for SAF-10 -- the register names this 'per-creator' only. `rule` is 'allow' (exempt from URL neutralisation) or 'deny' (always neutralised, wins over allow). A domain can hold at most one rule per channel.
